description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange with effect from 13.09.2021 to 19.09.2021
categorisation: This gazette notification announces new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges, issued under the authority of the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235). It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs operations, specifically governing how foreign currency conversions will be handled for customs purposes. The content involves legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel/structure changes, land, commercial, elections, public service, judicial, or other miscellaneous categories.
